Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.

779-1856-2178-4050-7409.description:

When the Wurms enter, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Doom Weaver trigger, pairing it and a Wurm.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wurm that's paired with Doom Weaver, adding {B/G}.
When the Wurm dies, it and Lluwen trigger.
Resolve the Wurm trigger, instead choosing to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lluwen trigger, untapping it.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 for each remaining Doom Weaver trigger, instead drawing a card normally in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.
779-1856-2178-4050-7409.notes: As you mill cards, inevitably more lands will end up in your graveyard, meaning you'll make more tokens over time. If you don't want to draw additional cards after resolving the first Doom Weaver trigger, simply choose not to pair Doom Weaver and the Wurm. If you create more than five Wurms, you can stop sacrificing them once you have sacrificed five of them.

Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.
